summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer 12 New Feature Demonstration: Automatic Creation of Fitting Garments ## Introduction In this demonstration, we will explore the new feature in Marvelous Designer 12 that allows for the automatic creation of fitting garments. This feature enhances the design workflow and improves efficiency in garment visualization. ## Importing Files To begin, click on the **File** menu located in the upper left corner and select **Import**. Then, choose either an **OPJ** or **FBX** file to import your design. ### Activating Automatic Creation In the import window, make sure to click on the **Automatically create a test穿服** function. This option is crucial for generating a fitting garment automatically. ## Display Virtual Model Settings Next, locate the **Display Virtual Model** settings in the 3D display window. Here, you can select the **Display Test穿服** option to visualize the fitting garment. ### Applying Test Garment Information To apply the test穿服 information to your costume, ensure that the costume is placed on a virtual model that has the test穿服 information. This step is essential for accurate fitting. ## Visualizing in 3D In the 3D display window, open the **Test穿服 Display**. This feature allows you to check and review the test穿服 information alongside the costume. ### Confirming Model Selection When you enter a new virtual model, confirm that you have selected the **Automatically create a test穿服** option. This confirmation ensures that the fitting garment is generated correctly. ## Automatic Adjustment Finally, utilize the **Automatically Adjust** version. The system will automatically adjust the costume to match the size of the virtual model, providing a seamless fitting experience. ## Conclusion The automatic creation of fitting garments in Marvelous Designer 12 streamlines the design process, allowing for quick and efficient adjustments to fit various virtual models. ```
